decisions.decision: Switched Mermaid from mmdc subprocess to client-side JS rendering

decisions.rationale: friendly had 2.76:1 contrast ratio on light bg, tango has 5.48:1 (passes AA)

decisions.decision: Figure img alt set to empty string, figcaption provides description
decisions.rationale: Prevents duplicate alt text display in Chrome when image fails to load
